items.exampleEn: This parking area is exclusively for visitors.
items.exampleZh: 這個停車區僅供訪客使用。

items.exampleEn: Sarah thanked the team, and the manager did likewise.
items.exampleZh: Sarah 向團隊道謝，經理也這麼做了。

items.exampleEn: The rules have changed, so please act accordingly.
items.exampleZh: 規定改了，請照著調整你的做法。

items.exampleEn: Additionally, all staff will get an extra day off.
items.exampleZh: 此外，全體員工會多放一天假。

items.exampleEn: You can pay by card. Alternatively, you can pay in cash.
items.exampleZh: 你可以刷卡，或者也可以付現金。

items.exampleEn: Neither of the two printers is working.
The new office is somewhat smaller than the old one.
items.exampleZh: 新辦公室比舊的稍微小一點。

items.exampleEn: Do we necessarily need to finish it today?
items.exampleZh: 我們一定要今天完成嗎？

items.sentenceEn: On Fridays, we use the big meeting room exclusively for training.
items.sentenceZh: 每週五，大會議室只用來做訓練。

items.audioEn: Neither of the trains stops here. Alternatively, you can take a bus to the station.
items.audioZh: 兩班火車都不停這裡。或者，你可以搭公車到車站。
options: Take a bus to the station
Wait here for the next train
Walk to the next town instead

items.sentenceEn: I was somewhat surprised by the results of the survey.
items.sentenceZh: 我對調查結果有點驚訝。

items.sentenceEn: A high price does not necessarily mean high quality.
items.sentenceZh: 價格高不一定代表品質好。

items.stemEn: Our budget has been cut, so we must plan ____.
items.stemZh: 我們的預算被刪減了，所以必須相應地做規劃。

items.stemEn: The hotel has a free gym. ____, breakfast is included in the price.
items.stemZh: 這家飯店有免費的健身房。此外，房價還包含早餐。

items.passageEn: From next Monday, the third-floor kitchen will be used exclusively by the design team, because they need space for a new project. Other staff can use the kitchen on the fifth floor. Alternatively, they can eat in the small garden behind the building. We know this change is somewhat inconvenient. The fifth-floor kitchen will be busier, but that does not necessarily mean longer lines, since we will add a second coffee machine there. Additionally, the company will pay for lunch every Friday this month. Neither the kitchen rule nor the extra coffee machine is permanent. We will review them in three months and adjust our plans accordingly. Linda at the front desk will listen to your ideas, and the managers will likewise read every comment.
items.passageZh: 從下週一起，三樓的廚房將只給設計團隊使用，因為他們的新專案需要空間。其他員工可以使用五樓的廚房，或者也可以在大樓後面的小花園用餐。我們知道這項改變有點不方便。五樓的廚房會比較擁擠，但這不一定代表要排更久，因為我們會在那裡多放一台咖啡機。此外，本月每週五公司會請大家吃午餐。廚房規定和多加的咖啡機都不是永久的。我們會在三個月後檢討，並據此調整計畫。櫃台的 Linda 會聽取大家的想法，經理們也同樣會閱讀每一則意見。

questions.questionZh: 從下週一起，誰可以使用三樓的廚房？
公司打算怎麼處理這些改變？

items.promptZh: 我們可以搭火車去，或者也可以開車去。
referenceEn: We can go by train. Alternatively, we can drive.
We can take the train, or alternatively, we can drive there.
rubricZh: alternatively 用來提出另一個選擇（例如放在第二句句首：Alternatively, we can drive.；也可接在 or 後面）
「搭火車去」可寫 go by train、take the train 等；「開車去」可寫 drive、drive there、go by car 等

items.promptZh: 她的第一本小說很受歡迎，第二本也同樣受歡迎。
referenceEn: Her first novel was very popular, and her second one was likewise popular.
Her first novel was very popular. Likewise, her second novel sold very well.
rubricZh: likewise 表示「同樣地」，可放動詞後或句首（例如 was likewise popular、Likewise, … 等）
「很受歡迎」可寫，例如 very popular、sold very well、a big hit 等
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 was、is 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似："Neither of these changes is permanent." 前文列了三件以上的改變（三樓廚房專用、五樓加咖啡機、每週五請午餐），neither 只用於兩者，指涉不清；且「本月每週五請午餐」本來就有期限，說它不是永久的多餘。建議改 None of these changes 或明確只指兩件事，passageZh「這兩項改變」同步調整。
